This is the MIT-licensed braces 3.0.3 source from https://github.com/micromatch/braces, retaining its original LICENSE. Waydidi adds iterative depth/size checks before parsing and recursive AST walkers to mitigate GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, which has no published upstream patch as of this audit. The fork uses a distinct package name/version and is installed as the `braces` dependency through npm overrides. Remove this fork when an upstream patch can replace it; do not remove the regression tests.
